h1: Seacrest Beach "How Sweet It Is" 59 W. Endless Summer Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Access to the 12,000-square-foot community pool- Complimentary Shuttle Service to the beach March 2-October 31- 4 Adult Bikes- Community amenities- Nearby shopping and dining- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutPlease note this community requires a Guest Registration Form to be completed within two weeks of arrival to access the community amenities.DETAILS: How Sweet It Is in Seacrest Beach is a 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom beach cottage that sleeps 10. Guests will enjoy a comfortable front porch, a second-floor balcony, access to a 12,000-square-foot community pool, and a seasonal beach shuttle service.An inviting front porch with Adirondack chairs welcomes guests to How Sweet It Is. Around the corner, guests can enjoy a hanging bench swing and an outdoor shower. Stepping inside the home, guests will find a coastal chic open living, dining, and kitchen area decorated in pale shades of cream, gray, and driftwood. Slipcovered sofas and chairs are split into two gathering spaces. Guests can curl up on the sofa and enjoy the 65” Smart TV or unwind on cozy armchairs and share stories of the day. An oval dining table seats 6 and leads to a kitchen with marble counters and luxurious extras like a wine cooler, a cappuccino machine, and a touch-activated faucet. Off the kitchen is a guest bedroom with a king bed and a private bathroom.On the second floor, guests will find a bunk room with a twin-over-twin bunk bed that shares a bathroom with a guest bedroom with a queen bed. The primary bedroom has a king bed and a spacious sitting area with a sofa that opens to a large balcony. The bedroom’s private bathroom has a jacuzzi tub and a separate shower.Guests can easily explore Seacrest Beach and neighboring Rosemary Beach on 4 included adult bikes. A complimentary beach shuttle makes going back and forth to the beach a breeze. With this wonderful location and fabulous interiors, How Sweet It Is will book quickly, so book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 8):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed and 2 Twin Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Jacuzzi Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, and Callista Vacation Rentals fines.

DETAILS: How Sweet It Is in Seacrest Beach is a 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom beach cottage that sleeps 10. Guests will enjoy a comfortable front porch, a second-floor balcony, access to a 12,000-square-foot community pool, and a seasonal beach shuttle service. An inviting front porch with Adirondack chairs welcomes guests to How Sweet It Is. Around the corner, guests can enjoy a hanging bench swing and an outdoor shower. Off the kitchen is a guest bedroom with a king bed and a private bathroom. On the second floor, guests will find a bunk room with a twin-over-twin bunk bed that shares a bathroom with a guest bedroom with a queen bed. The primary bedroom has a king bed and a spacious sitting area with a sofa that opens to a large balcony. The bedroom’s private bathroom has a jacuzzi tub and a separate shower. Guests can easily explore Seacrest Beach and neighboring Rosemary Beach on 4 included adult bikes. A complimentary beach shuttle makes going back and forth to the beach a breeze. With this wonderful location and fabulous interiors, How Sweet It Is will book quickly, so book today!
